grounding.states: No open Costco in Oakville yet; the first one is planned on Wyecroft Road near Burloak Drive
grounding.from: Oakville, Ontario has no open Costco yet. The first Oakville warehouse is under development. An "Opening Soon" sign has gone up at the Wyecroft Road site near Burloak Drive.

grounding.states: The closest open warehouses are in Burlington and Mississauga
grounding.from: reports that the closest warehouses today are in Burlington and Mississauga

grounding.states: Burlington showed closed today, Monday Oct 12, Canadian Thanksgiving, per Apple Maps
grounding.from: Apple Maps showed it closed today, Monday Oct 12, which is Canadian Thanksgiving.

value.answer: There's no open Costco in Oakville yet. The first one is going up on Wyecroft Rd near Burloak Dr, with an opening target of fall 2027. For now the closest open ones are in Burlington (1225 Brant St) and Mississauga (3180 Laird Rd). I couldn't check drive times, so I can't say which is nearer. Apple Maps has the Burlington one closed today for Thanksgiving, so it's worth a call before you head out.
